summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (typed parameters and return, stdlib only, implements the validation and path-resolution workflow). Added an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading only, and all three Python files are within 120 columns. Beyond the spec I added a ValueError when the value under data_list_key is not a list, and I use os.path.isfile so a directory path also raises ValueError. Nothing was committed. The "~~~" heading may render at a different section level than expected; check it in the built docs.
